method.boa_offset_note: The item declares a -0.1 BOA offset and a boa_offset_applied flag that contradict each other. Applying the offset drives red-edge and red reflectance negative over vegetation pixels and NDVI above 1, so it was rejected on physical grounds.
method.note: NDVI saturates over mature palm and is carried only to show that it does. NDRE is the layer that separates blocks.
